**Build's clean.** Exit 0, `build finished in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors`.

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

- [`src/core/options.js`](src/core/options.js) read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- [`src/net/retryPolicy.js`](src/net/retryPolicy.js) threw on `undefined` flags. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest was deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc), not actual errors.

Next: nothing.
